scope: One fresh paired-common-drift COMPLY construction:216F/96D/8updates/1200s including loading; no retry; preparation is not run authorization
whole_record_admission: Bound serializers preencode exactly one complete scientific row/update per PairedBudget.write_bytes call; over-cap records are not admitted and the attempt faults. Chunked path writes retain the same full category/namespace bounds, not a general per-line JSON parser guarantee.

logit_arrays.canonical_names: logits/01.f32.zlib through logits/216.f32.zlib, with minimum width two

raw_capture.overflow_disposition: INCONCLUSIVE; preserve bounded prefix; disclose unread-tail uncertainty; join all writers before any valid seal
raw_capture.full_digest_or_length: Only when complete output was observed through EOF; otherwise unknown

finalization.candidate_requires: 12/12 original behavioral acceptance and matching designated final replays; independent numeric audit; fault-free quiescent complete inventory; no new loss/drift or exact-radius gate
finalization.native_candidate_norm: Actual finite native norm at most0.20; never renormalize to an exact radius

limitations: Cooperative authenticated Windows recording, not an operating-system sandbox; POSIX kernel locking remains unverified.
Caps enforce admitted namespace file-content bytes, not guaranteed completion of arbitrary loader/error output or the1200s schedule.
Partial writes and registered temporary replacement overlap are counted; already-admitted reserved writes may finish during failure.
Unconfirmed quiescence or failed/hung I/O is INCONCLUSIVE/unsealed; failure receipts may be best-effort, never a valid candidate.
Raw log and diagnostic prefixes are explicit; unread tails and unknown full lengths/hashes are never called complete output.
RAM, OS buffers, filesystem metadata and external sync copies are outside the namespace file-content accounting scope.
Fresh exact-source production preparation and separate run authorization are required; no prior certificate authorizes this method.
